title: Deep learning uncovers hidden power of low-affinity motifs.
one_liner_zh: 该文利用序列-功能深度学习模型系统绘制小鼠胚胎干细胞中低亲和力先锋因子结合位点，揭示其通过软语法核小体协同性促进染色质开放的机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA结合与互作机制建模，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Low-affinity transcription factor binding sites are functionally important but difficult to map and mechanistically poorly understood. In this issue of Cell Genomics, Weilert et al. leverage sequence-to-function deep learning models to systematically map low-affinity pioneer factor binding sites in mouse embryonic stem cells and reveal how these sites contribute to chromatin opening through soft-syntax nucleosomal cooperativity.
abstract_zh: 低亲和力转录因子结合位点在功能上很重要，但难以定位且机制上理解不足。在本期《细胞基因组学》中，Weilert等人利用序列到功能的深度学习模型，系统性地定位了小鼠胚胎干细胞中的低亲和力先锋因子结合位点，并揭示了这些位点如何通过软语法核小体协同性促进染色质开放。
